blocks.text: Verse 1 uses a recurring formula that marks the end of one of Matthew’s large collections of Jesus’ teaching. Five such formulas structure the Gospel’s major teaching sections, though their repetition does not establish one universally accepted symbolic outline for the book.

In verse 10, Jesus applies messenger language to John the Baptist, and verse 14 also connects John with Elijah language. Matthew, Mark, and Luke use these themes in relation to John; how exactly they should be understood remains disputed.
